d:
Halki-phulki bhukh ka parphekt ilaj - chiji pav vara! , ekdam yunik aur testi, bahar se kurkura, andar se pighalta huaa chiz. gar aap roz ke nashte se bor ho gae hain, to ye Cheese Stuffed Pav Vada banaeeye aur hari chatni aur tamatar sos ke sath sarv kijiye. Breakfast, Evening Snack aur Kids Lunch Box ke liye ekdam parphekt.
